title: LLM4POL problem spec -- charter section 7 (M3 freeze), CONTEXT D-05
description: The problem a run is opened on: one objective property with a direction, at most eight constraints on other registry properties, the objective form, the per-iteration budget, the pinned snapshot and the seed. Every object is closed and `schema_version` is pinned. The property enums repeat the nine keys of property-registry.json (a test compares the two lists, so the list is not published twice). This body has no internal reference so ledger-event.json can embed it verbatim as `$defs/problem`. A change that a reported result depends on is a new schema version in a new file (charter section 4 A-5), never an edit of this one once results cite it.

form.description: `constrained_single` is the only form at M3. `pareto` is reserved for the D-16 gate (objective form, fixed at the Phase 7 pre-registration) and arrives as a new schema version, not as an edit of this enum.
